events.description: Draw the limited domain graph of f(x) and highlight the 'Limited Domain' interval on the x-axis.
events.clip_query: A blue graph plotted on a set of axes over a limited domain with a label reading 'Limited Domain' below it.

events.description: Animate random extensions of the graph to the left and right, morphing through multiple configurations.
events.clip_query: Red curves extending from both ends of a blue graph, morphing and shifting randomly to show non-uniqueness.

events.description: A tangent line slides smoothly along the blue limited domain graph.
events.clip_query: A white tangent line sliding along a blue curve on a set of mathematical axes.

events.description: The extensions are replaced by a full graph that wiggles dynamically to represent alternative smooth extensions.
events.clip_query: A red graph on axes whose outer ends wiggle up and down while the center remains perfectly still.
